crossRefs.note: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your…
Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but…
If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness…
“For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim.
For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

translations.web: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
translations.bsb: I will say to God: Do not condemn me! Let me know why You prosecute me.
translations.kjv: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest
translations.asv: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; Show me wherefore thou contendest with me.
